articles.title: Abalone Crack Inlay
articles.summary: Pearly island shards in dark grout; fine crackle, low sheen, subtle iridescent depth Reads as a soft mosaic of pearly patches with dark seams, strongest where the highlight crosses; the striations blur into a gentle satin shimmer.
articles.what: Abalone shard inlay with pearly islands and dark grout. Up close: Irregular rounded shell islands 60-150 px wide separated by dark grout channels, like a cracked mosaic. Each island carries fine diagonal pinstripe striations that catch the light; grout stays dull and flat. A pocket of tight hatching shows at the bottom. From a distance: Reads as a soft mosaic of pearly patches with dark seams, strongest where the highlight crosses; the striations blur into a gentle satin shimmer. It changes the shine only, never the colour. Channels it touches: metal, roughness, clearcoat. Group: Definitive Spec Replacements (Legacy collection tab of the spec overlay picker). Texture detail: fine.
when: Best on: hero panel, trim, hood.
how: Click a zone card and expand SPEC OVERLAYS.
Click + ADD SPEC OVERLAY, open the Legacy collection tab and the group "Definitive Spec Replacements", or search for "Abalone Crack Inlay".
Click it, then click Add this overlay in the Inspect surface window.
Set Strength (default 50%) and tick the Metallic, Roughness and Clearcoat boxes you want.
Use Size and Rotation to make the texture finer, then render.
tips: Hood and roof: islands are big enough to read
Avoid small trim and spoiler edges: cells swallow them
Numbers keep their colour; the grout seams can cut through thin outlines, so use bold numbers.
Quiet: islands lift slightly, grout drops back; a restrained cracked-tile sheen
Pairs well with: gloss, metallic, matte, pearl.
pitfalls: Not a coloured abalone paint: it adds no pearl colour, only shine variation
Not hex scales: cells are irregular and rounded with wide grout
Avoid: too dark grout hides shards, avoid on large flat body panels.
articles.intent_note: A spec pattern changes the shine only: metal, roughness and clearcoat, never the paint colour.
articles.paint_advice: It cannot recolour anything. Metal added to a light paint looks bright; metal added to a dark paint stays dark, because metal reflection inherits the paint colour. Pair it with a paint that gives the gloss difference something to show on.

combos.why: Up to five overlays stack in order; a strong overlay can wash out the ones below it.
The blend mode decides how this overlay meets the base shine. Normal is the safe start.
Coat values 1 to 15 and roughness under 15 on non-chrome pixels are raised to safe values on export.

examples.title: Add it as an overlay
examples.goal: Layer Abalone Crack Inlay over a base finish.
examples.result: The shine of the zone gets this texture while the colours stay put.
